$comment: Generation roots. Scope is the transitive $ref closure of everything named here; internal/cmd/schemagen computes it and CI fails if the exported set differs. See README.md#manifestjson for what each bucket means and when it retires.

internal.$comment: Generated but not exported: JSON-RPC plumbing a caller never names. Each value says why. An exported definition that reaches one of these is a generation failure, because a published type whose field a caller cannot name is worse than no type.
internal.CancelRequestNotification: the params of $/cancel_request, which the connection sends on its own behalf; a caller cancels by cancelling a context
internal.RequestId: a JSON-RPC request identifier, which the API never surfaces: not request IDs, not the envelope, not the method strings

probes.$comment: Layer-1 wire-shape probes. Each key is a definition; each value is the shape it proves that no payload root reaches yet. Entries leave as the payload roots grow to reach the same shapes.
probes.MultiSelectItems: an open object union: a `not` catch-all arm, an untagged arm, and extra properties that must survive

projections.$comment: Handle-facing params types: the generated wire request minus the identifiers a handle owns.
